description: This file implements the standard mathematical library for Lua, defining various math functions and constants, and registering them for use within Lua scripts.

methods.name: math_abs
methods.description: Calculates the absolute value of a number.

methods.name: math_sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of a number.

methods.name: math_sinh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a number.

methods.name: math_cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of a number.

methods.name: math_cosh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

methods.name: math_tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of a number.

methods.name: math_tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a number.

methods.name: math_asin
methods.description: Calculates the arcsine of a number.

methods.name: math_acos
methods.description: Calculates the arccosine of a number.

methods.name: math_atan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of a number.

methods.name: math_atan2
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of y/x considering the signs of both arguments.

methods.name: math_ceil
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of a number.

methods.name: math_floor
methods.description: Calculates the floor of a number.

methods.name: math_fmod
methods.description: Calculates the floating-point modulus of two numbers.

methods.name: math_modf
methods.description: Splits a number into integer and fractional parts.

methods.name: math_sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number.

methods.name: math_pow
methods.description: Calculates a number raised to a power.

methods.name: math_log
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a number.

methods.name: math_log10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a number.

methods.name: math_exp
methods.description: Calculates e raised to a power.

methods.name: math_deg
methods.description: Converts radians to degrees.

methods.name: math_rad
methods.description: Converts degrees to radians.

methods.name: math_frexp
methods.description: Breaks a number into normalized fraction and exponent.

methods.name: math_ldexp
methods.description: Multiplies a number by 2 raised to an exponent.

methods.name: math_min
methods.description: Finds the minimum of multiple numbers.

methods.name: math_max
methods.description: Finds the maximum of multiple numbers.

methods.name: math_random
methods.description: Generates a random number.

methods.name: math_randomseed
methods.description: Sets the seed for random number generation.
